name: limit_combine_with_body_read_before_the_cut
why: ENTRY Z-C21.2, finding L6-1, on the model of entry E4. Up to library 0.136.0 combine_bodies read «C2» as «the second of a GetBodies2 done now» and did not look at the state: IPartDoc~GetBodies2.html, Remarks, «May vary the order in which bodies are returned». A plan written by looking at the state once — two blocks, a cut, then the boolean with the name read BEFORE the cut — combined a body that was no longer the one seen, with `succeeded: true`. `move_bodies` has refused it since 14/9/2026 (`BodiesFromUid` + `SignatureMatches`); combine_bodies now goes through the same point.
defect_caught: Step 4 carries the uid of the original block read BEFORE the cut («uid_from_step»: 3), with its signature: centre (0, 0, 5), bounding box 100 x 50 x 10. The cut of step 3 shortens that block by 15 mm on the left, so no body of now has that signature any more: in its place there is either the shortened block (centre moved by 5 mm) or the copy (centre at x = 60), depending on how GetBodies2 lists them. In both cases the name no longer indicates the body seen, and the operation must refuse. On the old library the union SUCCEEDED: the two bodies still overlap, and the volume came out plausible.
_and_the_twin_is_in_the_same_file: Step 5 is the same union without the name read earlier: the default main body, on the bodies of now. It differs from the refusal by one argument, «main_body_uid», and it succeeds: it proves that the refusal comes from the old name and not from two bodies that cannot be united.
_the_numbers: Block 100 x 50 x 10 centred: x from -50 to 50. Copy at dx = 60: x from 10 to 110, overlapping by 40 x 50 x 10 = 20000. The through cut 15 x 70 centred at x = -47.5 removes the strip x from -50 to -40 of the block only (x from -55 to -40, outside the copy): 10 x 50 x 10 = 5000. After: 45000 + 50000 = 95000 in two bodies. The union: x from -40 to 110, that is 150 x 50 x 10 = 75000 in one body.

steps._why_x_0: the front faces are two, one per body; GetClosestPointOn(0,0,0) puts the one of the block at x = 0 and the one of the copy at x = 10

expect.why: the cut shortens the block, it does not split it, and it does not touch the copy

message_includes: I do not work on the wrong body
